disagreements: V2-03 ended_placeholder: it wants 'Gui de mo lai…' because French/Spanish/Chinese/Russian dropped the destination. This audit rejects that: the vi string is 259 pt against English's 266.7 pt, so vi cannot be the cause of an English-source 200% clip, and dropping 'trong thu muc home' would lose information the English keeps.

V2-04 rejected: it reads 'chua duoc luu' as 'not saved yet' and wants 'khong duoc luu'. The string is byte-identical to core's relay.account_policy.rejected; changing it in this client alone would split the surfaces the mirror rule keeps aligned. Recorded, not changed.
chip type role: its chip widths were measured at body-sm 14/400; the rows use buttonClasses('quiet','md') -> text-label 15/600, which is what this audit measured. Both agree every chip fits.

findings.current: Tùy chọn khởi đầu của cuộc trò chuyện này đã cố định. Dùng Chi tiết cuộc trò chuyện để xem các điều khiển trực tiếp.
findings.problem: “để xem các điều khiển trực tiếp” narrows the destination to VIEWING the live controls. The English says the sentence exists to send the reader to the controls that are still live — the one action left once the starting options are fixed. `xem` turns the redirect into a read-only pointer, on the exact sentence that has to carry the action.
findings.replacement: Tùy chọn khởi đầu của cuộc trò chuyện này đã cố định. Mở Chi tiết cuộc trò chuyện để dùng các điều khiển trực tiếp.
findings.evidence: English source + context note ('Explains why the starting options are read-only once the conversation has started'). Replacement keeps the reader's path and the title `Chi tiết cuộc trò chuyện`, which must match mobile.session.conversation_details.

findings.current: yêu cầu chạy song song để tách ra tác nhân con
findings.problem: Overflows the one-line tip row at the narrowest supported phone. Measured 278.6 pt of text at meta 12/500; the row at 320 pt is 288 pt, and the row's own Info icon (12 pt) plus its gap (6 pt) leave a 270 pt text box. Content is 296.6 pt against 288 pt — 8.6 pt over. The row is content-sized, single-line (numberOfLines={1}) and centred in the column, so the overflow is cut at both viewport edges rather than wrapping. English's widest tip is 268.9 pt, inside the 270 pt slot. The 48-character TIP_CHAR_BUDGET at 46 characters passes while the line does not fit: characters are not a width budget in Vietnamese.
findings.replacement: yêu cầu chạy song song để tách tác nhân con
findings.evidence: CoreText/AppKit measurement, system font: current 278.6 pt; replacement 263.7 pt (fits the 270 pt text box with 6.3 pt headroom); 43 characters. Only `ra` is removed; meaning and the pool's lower-case fragment register are unchanged.

findings.current: Hôm nay tôi có thể giúp gì cho bạn?
findings.problem: Wraps at 320 pt where English holds one line, and leaves a one-word widow. Measured 315.8 pt at title 20/600 against 288 pt of content width; the break lands after “cho” (267.8 pt), so line 2 is only “bạn?” (43.7 pt) — a dangling pronoun with the question mark. English is 281.9 pt and stays on one line. The extra line also costs the splash 26 pt, which is the row the tip occupies at the bottom of the yield order.
findings.replacement: Hôm nay tôi có thể giúp gì?
findings.evidence: Measured 240.2 pt, one line. Drops the pronoun the style guide tells the translator to drop (“Vietnamese drops pronouns: do not write bạn in every string”). If the explicit addressee matters more than “today”, the alternative “Tôi có thể giúp gì cho bạn?” measures 235.8 pt and drops “Hôm nay” instead.

findings.current: Đang khởi động… · Chưa xác nhận khởi động
findings.problem: One English verb (start) is rendered with two Vietnamese ones on the same screen: `khởi động` here and in `startup_queue.unconfirmed`, but `bắt đầu` in `startup_queue.not_started` (“Chưa bắt đầu”), which sits in the same row family. `khởi động` also reads first as a machine or app booting, while this state is the first send's conversation starting.
findings.replacement: Đang bắt đầu… · Chưa xác nhận bắt đầu
findings.evidence: Measured: 136.2 pt (was 157.3) for `starting`, 148.6 pt (was 163.6) for `unconfirmed` — both inside one 288 pt line. `Tùy chọn khởi đầu` in options.fixed is the noun “initial”, a different sense, and is left alone.

findings.current: Đánh thức tôi kèm tóm tắt
findings.problem: `kèm tóm tắt` attaches a bare verb-noun to a preposition that wants a noun phrase; the classifier `bản` is what makes it read as “a summary”. As written the chip reads slightly clipped, like a truncated list item rather than a request.
findings.replacement: Đánh thức tôi kèm bản tóm tắt
findings.evidence: Measured 212.8 pt in the 256 pt chip box (current 182.6 pt; English 180.0 pt), so the longer wording costs no fit. 27 characters — the measured `vi` chip budget the wave must add has to be at least 27, not English's 24.

findings.problem: Core's committed Vietnamese for the code-review feature is `rà soát` (10 values in `tui.review.*`: `rà soát mã`, `chờ rà soát lại`, `đã rà soát …`), so `đánh giá` names the same feature with a second word once this client ships. It also puts two chips on the same visible first word (`Đánh giá …` and `Đánh thức …`), which is the scannability the pool's leading-verb rule exists to protect.
findings.evidence: Measured 117.5 pt in the 256 pt chip box (current 127.2 pt). `rà soát` is core's own term for the review feature; `repo` stays Latin as the context note requires.
